title: Oracle at Delphi as a burning methane seep

tellings.quote: oracle at Deli was a methane seep, a burning methane seep.

plain: The Oracle at Delphi was an ancient Greek shrine where a priestess gave prophecies. A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says the oracle was really a burning methane seep, a spot where natural gas leaked out of the ground and burned. If so, the shrine's power would have come from the earth itself.
